contentFieldHelp: Please do not edit or change any aspect of the original text and choose to add full speeches instead of out of context claims (Twitter and general social media posts are OK).
dateFieldHelp: When was this speech released or told? Not the date you are adding it to Aletheia.
dateFieldHelpImage: When was this released ? Not the date you are adding it to Aletheia.
dateFieldHelpDebate: When was this debate held? Not necessarily the date you are adding it to Aletheia.
disclaimer: * The Add speech tool is only available for manually adding real speeches and claims made by said personality. Any attempt to dissiminate fake news through this platform is utterly forbidden and will result on user ban and possible lawsuit.
errorAcceptTerms: You need to accept the terms to submit the form
checkboxAcceptTerms: I personally atest that all information added is truthful.
selectContentModel: What claim format do you want to add?
selectPersonalityText: Select the personality who made this claim
personalityAlreadyAdded: This personality is already added to the claim.
errorDuplicateTitle: A claim with this title already exists. Please choose a different title.

createForm.titleHelp: A short name to identify the claim in lists. The title is not fact-checked.
createForm.contentPlaceholder: Paste the original text here, without editing it.
createForm.contentHelp: Don't edit the original text. Prefer the full excerpt over out-of-context quotes.
createForm.discardWarning: to go back and discard what you filled in

Speech.sectionDescription: Paste the original text. Once created, the claim is split into sentences and each one can be fact-checked.
Speech.titlePlaceholder: E.g.: Interview on the evening news about the economy
Speech.dateHelp: When was this said or published?
Speech.sourceGuidance: Proof that this was said or published. E.g.: a video, an official transcript, a post by the personality themselves, a news article quoting the statement.
Speech.sourceLabel: Where was this claim said or published?
Speech.sourceHelp: We accept news websites, academic papers, official documents and posts on the personality's own social media.
Speech.publishDescription: Once published, the claim becomes available for fact-checking.
Speech.disclaimer: * This tool is only for adding real statements and speeches. Any attempt to spread fake news is prohibited and may result in a ban and legal action.

Image.sectionDescription: Upload the image as it is circulating. It will be the item fact-checked.
Image.titlePlaceholder: E.g.: Flood photo attributed to Rio Grande do Sul
Image.contentHelp: The image is fact-checked as a whole. It is not split into parts.
Image.fileHint: PNG or JPG, up to 10 MB. You can also drag the file here.
Image.sourceDescription: Where the image was published or is circulating.
Image.sourceGuidance: Proof of where the image was published or is circulating. E.g.: a social media post, a forwarded message, a news article reproducing the image.
Image.sourceLabel: Where was the image published or where is it circulating?
Image.sourceHelp: We accept news websites, social media posts, forwarded messages and official documents.
Image.publishDescription: Once published, the image becomes available for fact-checking.
Image.disclaimer: * This tool is only for adding images that have actually circulated. Any attempt to spread fake news is prohibited and may result in a ban and legal action.

Debate.sectionDescription: Statements are not added now. They will be added during or after the debate and become fact-checkable sentences.
Debate.dateHelp: When did or will the debate take place?
Debate.sourceDescription: Official page, broadcast or coverage of the debate.
Debate.sourceGuidance: Proof that the debate took place or will take place. E.g.: official page, live broadcast, announcement by the broadcaster or organizers.
Debate.sourceLabel: Where was or will the debate be broadcast?
Debate.sourceHelp: We accept official pages, broadcasts, news websites and announcements by the broadcaster or organizers.
Debate.publishDescription: Once created, the debate is ready to receive the statements that will be fact-checked.
Debate.disclaimer: * This tool is only for adding real debates. Any attempt to spread fake news is prohibited and may result in a ban and legal action.

Unattributed.sectionDescription: Paste the original text. Once created, the information is split into sentences and each one can be fact-checked.
Unattributed.titlePlaceholder: E.g.: Rumor about the new vaccination schedule
Unattributed.dateHelp: When did this information start circulating?
Unattributed.sourceDescription: Where this information was published or is circulating.
Unattributed.sourceGuidance: Proof that this information was published or is circulating. E.g.: a social media post, a forwarded message, a video, a news article reproducing the content.
Unattributed.sourceLabel: Where was this information published or where is it circulating?
Unattributed.sourceHelp: We accept news websites, academic papers, official documents and social media posts.
Unattributed.publishDescription: Once published, the information becomes available for fact-checking.
Unattributed.disclaimer: * This tool is only for adding information that has actually circulated. Any attempt to spread fake news is prohibited and may result in a ban and legal action.
